gloss: to name; to give a name to

definitions.gloss: to name, to give a name to, to call
definitions.explanation: To assign a name to a person, place, thing, or concept. Used for the act of choosing and bestowing a name.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんに{名前|なまえ}を{名付|なづ}ける。
examples.english: To give a name to a baby.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{娘|むすめ}を「さくら」と{名付|なづ}けた。
この{通|とお}りは、{昔|むかし}ここにあった{桜|さくら}の{木|き}にちなんで「さくら{通|どお}り」と{名付|なづ}けられた。
examples.english: This street was named 'Sakura-dori' after the cherry trees that used to be here.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the passive form {名付|なづ}けられた (was named). The pattern AをBと{名付|なづ}ける means "to name A as B." Also written as {名|な}づける.

CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}).
- Negative: {名付|なづ}けない
- Polite: {名付|なづ}けます
- Te-form: {名付|なづ}けて
- Past: {名付|なづ}けた
- Passive: {名付|なづ}けられる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～と{名付|なづ}ける: to name as ~
- {名付|なづ}け{親|おや}: godparent; person who names something
- ～にちなんで{名付|なづ}ける: to name after ~
